settings.title: Heavy Industries
settings.challenge: Safety-sensitive work, contractor movements, remote sites and roster variation can magnify gaps when procedures differ between locations.
settings.support: Documented procedures, trained collectors, specimen-integrity and chain-of-custody controls, maintained equipment, consistent records and scheduled program reviews.

settings.title: Transport & Logistics
settings.challenge: Dispersed and shift-based operations must account for different sector rules, fitness-for-work expectations and practical site conditions.
settings.support: A role- and site-aligned process, trained collectors and supervisors, equipment controls, chain-of-custody documentation and central records.

settings.category: Police · Corrections · Defence · Councils · Emergency Services
settings.title: Government & Critical Services
settings.challenge: Public accountability, workforce diversity and high-consequence roles require a consistent process that also respects privacy and dignity.
settings.support: Defined responsibilities, consistent collection and escalation procedures, competency records, secure reporting and a clear audit trail.

settings.category: Hospitals · Aged Care · Disability · Community Services
settings.title: Healthcare & Community
settings.challenge: Duty of care must be balanced with informed consent, confidentiality, privacy and dignity across varied care settings.
settings.support: A setting-appropriate method, trained staff, clear consent and privacy steps, specimen-integrity controls and secure, restricted records.

settings.title: Workplace & Corporate
settings.challenge: Different job risks and limited in-house specialist knowledge can lead to inconsistent policy decisions, testing steps and records.
settings.support: A risk-based policy, supervisor guidance, fit-for-purpose equipment, a documented process and periodic review as the workplace changes.
